avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces vemurafenib levels by 30-50%, decreasing efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Consult oncologist for alternatives

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases vemurafenib plasma concentrations

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase bleeding risk and potentiate QT prolongation with vemurafenib
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to <400 IU daily; obtain oncologist approval before supplementation

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Pomegranate supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases vemurafenib levels, raising toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; choose alternative citrus supplements if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginger supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have anticoagulant properties; additive bleeding risk with vemurafenib's known effects
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; inform oncology team; monitor for signs of bleeding

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition; potential for minor vemurafenib level increase
caution_supplements.action: Permissible in moderate doses; monitor for increased toxicity symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut microbiota affecting vemurafenib absorption; minimal clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor GI tolerance; space dosing 2+ hours apart if used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases vemurafenib exposure and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and juice; substitute with other fruits

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate/Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition elevates vemurafenib levels

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase vemurafenib absorption; food effect documented in product labeling
caution_foods.action: Consistent meal pattern recommended; take with or without food consistently

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-rich foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Mild CYP1A2 substrate interaction; minimal clinical impact at typical intake
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake acceptable; excessive caffeine may increase QT prolongation risk

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of toxicity (rash, photosensitivity, QT prolongation, bleeding) as CYP3A4 inhibitors increase vemurafenib exposure. Counsel patients on strict avoidance of grapefruit/pomegranate and St. John's Wort; verify all new supplements with oncology prior to use given vemurafenib's narrow therapeutic window and serious adverse effect profile.
